name: aXtn Documents
description: Document inventory and detail surface over the canonical axtn_document_registry lifecycle backbone.
permissions: authenticated user subject to native dataset RLS
data_contracts: user-owned dataset named axtn_document_registry, written by document intake; each document row is identified by document_id and marked record_kind=document
rows describing the registry itself (record_kind=schema_seed and other seed/system rows) are excluded from the inventory

registration-stage fields consumed: document_id, source_ref, source_type/provider_type, drive_file_id (derived from source_ref/document_id when absent), content_hash, hash_algorithm, processing_status, privacy_status, extraction_status, schema_version, source_swarm_run_id, source_approval_id

later lifecycle fields consumed when a subsequent stage produces them: canonical/original filename, type/family, organisation or issuer, domain, document date, paths, PARA class, status, confidence, topics, source URL, MIME type, file size, modified/ingested time
read-only: the Workbench never writes to the registry outside the existing allowlisted metadata edit path
known_limitations: No persistence is introduced and the registry schema is not modified.
A registered document carries no semantic classification yet; those fields stay unresolved until a later lifecycle stage produces them, and are never inferred.
Filename, MIME type and content hash are not populated by the current intake stage even though the registry declares the columns.
AI Analyst support is pending rebinding to a native AI Analyst/data contract.
Mixed string and string-array topic contracts are intentionally not bulk editable.
